title: Anastomosis Artifact / Local Action Cache
objective: Eliminate repeated deterministic work by reusing only immutable verified Artifacts when action/WorkKey identity, provenance, freshness, integrity and compatibility all still match.

great_harvest_preflight.reason: 010N already harvested WorkKey/input-bound identity, refusal memory, unknown-is-not-fresh, crash-window honesty, stat/digest invalidation and action-cache principles. Reuse those laws rather than inventing a second cache architecture.

pandaos_reconstruction.rule: Preserve Panda-like persistent Work/progress/operator clarity at the OS surface, but expose this as native OTHRYS Artifact evidence. Do not create a Panda cache, Panda authority path or parallel Work engine.
pandaos_reconstruction.future_surface: A cache hit/refusal/invalidation must be explainable in Work/Progress as evidence, not hidden optimization magic.

laws: Cache state is derived/disposable; canonical source/evidence remains authoritative.
A reusable Artifact is immutable and content-digest bound.
Reuse requires exact legal identity plus provenance, freshness, integrity and compatibility validation.
Changed input/environment/acceptance identity is a miss, never a guessed hit.
Refusal and invalidation receive durable evidence identity so the same unsafe reuse is not rediscovered.
Unknown/corrupt/torn reuse evidence is not fresh and fails closed to recomputation.
Independent-verification Claims never reuse the execution/result they are meant to independently verify.
Reuse grants no new execution, approval, admission or promotion authority.
out_of_scope: No distributed CAS or remote artifact server
No automatic authority or acceptance from a cache hit
No PandaOS dependency or duplicate Panda backend
No mutation of harvested legacy/VTC/Hub repositories

slices.goal: Map current WorkKey/Claim/Artifact and harvested cache/refusal stock; freeze exact identity and invalidation contract.
Implement smallest local immutable Artifact record/store and deterministic reuse decision.
Persist bounded refusal/invalidation evidence outside reusable derived state.
Hostile tests for changed input, stale provenance, digest corruption, compatibility mismatch, torn evidence and independent-verifier non-reuse; then independent T590 proof.
